checks.name: item-1-the-cli-no-longer-accepts-a-trust-anchor
checks.summary: TestCLIResolvesItsOwnTrustAnchorAndHasNoPublicKeyFlag PASS. The --public-key flag is gone, so passing it fails argument parsing. A bundle carrying a valid signature over a valid manifest, signed by a key the machine's anchor does not hold, is refused and writes nothing into versions/. The legitimate bundle installs and prints its version. With the anchor removed from its fixed path, both install and run refuse with the anchor refusal before touching versions/ and before starting a child. An unknown verb and an empty argv are refused.

checks.name: item-2-launcher-verb-exists-and-starts-the-child-in-its-own-process-group
checks.summary: cmd/bootstrap gained the run verb: 'bootstrap run --channel stable|preview --root <root> --schema <n> [--launches N]' resolves root/<channel>, re-verifies the bytes on disk against the persisted manifest and signature under the fixed-path anchor set, probes runner.NamespaceConfinement.Probe, and starts the child. TestChildStartsInItsOwnProcessGroup PASS executes a real child through the production process starter and reads its process group from the kernel: with NewProcessGroup set, the child's pgid equals its own pid and differs from the launcher's; with it unset, the child inherits the launcher's group. The negative case is what shows the flag does something.

checks.name: item-3-runner-does-not-link-the-update-package
checks.summary: TestRunnerDoesNotLinkTheUpdatePackage PASS: 35 .go files under cmd/runner and internal/runner scanned with go/ast, none imports internal/update, and a zero-file scan of either directory fails the assertion so it cannot pass vacuously. TestBootstrapperIndependenceGuardIsVerified is the positive control: the matcher detects a synthetic file importing internal/update, detects a file importing a package under it, ignores a standard-library-only file, and confirms that cmd/bootstrap itself does link internal/update -- which is what makes the rule an asymmetry rather than a blanket ban, and what stops the guard below from being vacuous.
